baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated clauses فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ... شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ and وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُورًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: A divine barrier blocks the severe event's evil while the causative encounter replaces it with radiant freshness and joy. The two clauses therefore perform a negative-to-positive encounter reversal, not merely rescue followed by an unrelated gift.

activation_trace.role: Warding harm with a protective barrier supplies the blocking operation at the start of the reversal.
Evil and badness name the adverse content excluded by the barrier.
An event-day or severe occasion makes the day a concentrated ordeal rather than an ordinary date.
What one meets of good or ill supplies the shared encounter-frame in which evil is displaced by good.
Radiant freshness and beauty provide the visible positive term of the reversal.
Joy and ease provide the affective positive term that accompanies radiance.

changed_reading.before: Allah merely spares them from something bad on a particular day and then gives two pleasant rewards.
changed_reading.after: Allah changes the encounter itself: the severe occasion cannot deliver its evil, while radiance and joy are made to meet the protected people instead.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired accusatives نَضْرَةً وَسُرُورًا under the single verb وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Radiant freshness is externally legible, whereas the joy branch carries hidden delight and ease. Their grammatical pairing makes one bestowed state with an outward surface and an inward register.

activation_trace.role: Casting or setting something before another supplies the joint delivery of the two accusatives.
Fresh brightness, including bloom of face and foliage, supplies the visible surface of the state.
Hidden joy and ease supply the inward affective register paired with visible bloom.

changed_reading.before: Nadra and surur are near-synonymous pleasures listed for emphasis.
changed_reading.after: The pair describes whole-person restoration: well-being becomes visible as fresh radiance while being inhabited inwardly as joy and ease.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative verb وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ rather than a simple possession verb.
baseline_models.mechanism: The meeting branch gives the rewards directional agency: the protected people do not merely own radiance and joy but are brought face to face with a welcoming condition that comes toward them.

activation_trace.role: Two things coming face to face turns the reward into an encounter rather than an inventory.
Radiant freshness is the first condition brought into the encounter.
Joy and ease complete the welcoming condition that meets them.

changed_reading.before: The verse adds two objects to the recipients' future possessions.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages reception: radiance and joy are made to face and welcome people whose encounter with evil has been blocked.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root range carried by سُرُورًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: Alongside the direct joy-and-ease branch, the same root's place-of-settled-support branch gives surur a possible durable, postural texture. Joy may name not only an emotion but arrival in a condition where one can remain at ease.

activation_trace.role: Joy and ease keep the model anchored in the direct branch of the focus form.
A place of settled support supplies durability and bodily rest as an exploratory texture of joy.

changed_reading.before: Surur is a momentary feeling of happiness.
changed_reading.after: Surur can also suggest joy stabilized as settled ease, a condition in which the protected people can rest.

context_deltas.mechanism: The actors first complete a self-binding vow and repeatedly anticipate the feared event; Allah then performs the successful guarding. The sequence converts vigilant self-restraint into completed protection supplied from outside them.

activation_trace.role: Completion without deficiency makes their fulfillment an already completed human-side action.
Self-imposed obligation supplies the deliberate self-binding that precedes divine guarding.
Fear as expectation of harm supplies anticipatory vigilance toward the day.
Repeated expectation of harm immediately before the focus verse intensifies the anticipatory state.
Placing the self in protective caution supplies continuity between their vigilance and the focus root.
The protective barrier marks the achieved divine completion of what vigilance could only anticipate.

structural_cues: 76:7 sequences fulfillment and fear before the result introduced by فَ in 76:11.
76:10 repeats fear in the verse immediately preceding the focus ayah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fulfilled obligation, repeated fear, and WQY branches of caution and barrier; I infer a directional conversion from human vigilance to divine achieved guarding. A live alternative is simple recompense with no continuity between the two forms of guarding.

changed_reading.before: Protection is a unilateral rescue unrelated to the recipients' prior posture.
changed_reading.after: The divine act answers and completes their vigilant self-binding: what they could fear and guard against becomes what Allah actually keeps from reaching them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, the day's evil spreads outward, compacts inward, and bears weight. Read against those vectors, waqa is a barrier against a mobile pressure-field rather than a generic cancellation of moral badness.

activation_trace.role: A protective barrier supplies the spatial response to the contextual threat-vectors.
A severe event-day provides the common event to which the contextual descriptors attach.
Evil and badness identify the same adverse content later named in the focus verse.
Spreading after lightness gives the evil an outward, proliferating vector.
Accumulation, gathering, and closing together give the day a compacting pressure.
Weight opposed to lightness gives the same day a downward burden.

structural_cues: The deictic ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ in 76:11 gathers the prior descriptions in 76:7 and 76:10.
76:27 later reprises a day with a further physical descriptor, heavy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies spread, accumulation, and weight as branch images around the same day; I combine them into a spatial pressure-field and assign waqa the opposing barrier function. They can alternatively remain separate intensifiers of severity.

changed_reading.before: The evil of the day is an abstract bad consequence that Allah removes.
changed_reading.after: The evil is imagined as a spreading, compacting, weight-bearing force whose vectors are stopped at the protected people.

context_deltas.mechanism: They direct food outward while refusing repayment and thanks from its recipients; after the focus encounter, recompense is supplied and their striving is itself thanked. Radiance and joy can therefore function as embodied divine recognition that does not convert the original care into a human exchange.

activation_trace.role: Setting something before another makes radiance and joy the delivered form of recognition.
Radiant freshness makes recognition bodily and publicly legible.
Joy and ease make the same recognition inwardly experienced.
Feeding another supplies the outward care for which human return is renounced.
Reciprocating an act with its recompense names the exchange they explicitly do not seek from those fed.
Recognition of favor names the thanks they explicitly decline from human recipients.
Recompensing an act supplies the divine-side return immediately after the focus verse.
Work and earning identify the sustained human action that receives recognition.
Recognition of favor returns in passive form to their striving, reversing the earlier refusal of thanks.

structural_cues: 76:8-9 places action and renunciation of exchange before the focus result.
76:12 names recompense immediately afterward, and 76:22 closes the reward sequence by calling their striving thanked.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the refusal of human recompense and thanks, then divine recompense and thanked striving; I infer that the intervening radiance and joy are the embodied medium of that recognition. They may instead be rewards adjacent to, but not constitutive of, the recognition.

changed_reading.before: Radiance and joy are generic compensation for good conduct.
changed_reading.after: They are a nontransactional return: divine recognition becomes visible and felt precisely where the actors had refused to demand recognition from vulnerable people.

context_deltas.mechanism: The actors orient feeding toward the face or self of Allah; Allah then makes radiant face-bloom meet them. The focus radiance can be read as the visible return of a prior orientation rather than an arbitrary ornament.

activation_trace.role: Face and frontal orientation supply the bodily-spatial motif directed toward Allah.
Radiant freshness, including bloom of face, receives and visibly returns the face motif.
Face-to-face meeting supplies the directional bridge between orientation and returned radiance.

structural_cues: The same recipients speak of Allah's face in 76:9 and are acted upon by Allah in 76:11.
Only one intervening ayah separates the stated orientation from the radiant result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies وَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ and NDR's face-bloom branch; I infer a return of the face motif from intention to countenance. The live alternative is that wajh means aim or divine self with no facial reciprocity.

changed_reading.before: Nadra is an unspecified decorative brightness.
changed_reading.after: Nadra becomes the countenance-level return of action oriented toward Allah: inward intention is answered by visible face-bloom.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following scene turns a momentary barrier into an inhabitable cover: a garden also carries a shielding branch, thermal extremes are absent, and shade forms a close shelter. Protection is productive enclosure, not only subtraction of evil.

activation_trace.role: Warding harm with a barrier supplies the focus operation expanded by the following habitat.
A protective shield supplies the garden's latent continuity with waqa.
The sun and its glare provide one environmental extreme excluded from the enclosure.
Intense cold provides the opposite environmental extreme excluded from the enclosure.
Shelter and protective cover turn absence of extremes into a positive place of safety.

structural_cues: Garden, freedom from sun and cold, and lowered shade follow the focus protection without a scene break.
The reward description moves from a protective verb to nested environmental coverings.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies barrier, shield, excluded extremes, and shelter; I infer that the latter images spatially realize waqa as habitat. They may instead be separate rewards after protection has already ended.

changed_reading.before: Waqa ends once the day's evil is removed.
changed_reading.after: Waqa opens into a durable ecology of protection: danger is not only blocked, but replaced by a shielded and temperate place to inhabit.

context_deltas.mechanism: After laqqahum, benefits repeatedly move toward the recipients: fruit is near and made tractable, vessels circulate around them, and their Lord gives them drink. The reward world is reoriented into active reception, extending the focus verb's face-to-face directionality.

activation_trace.role: Face-to-face meeting supplies the directional pattern extended by the following scene.
Nearness and approach make part of the environment move within reach.
Making something tractable after difficulty removes resistance from the approaching fruit.
Circling around something supplies repeated service directed toward the recipients.
Giving drink directly supplies the culminating act of reception.
Nurturing, setting right, and bringing to completion identify the host-like agency behind the drink.

structural_cues: Repeated passives and causatives in 76:14-21 orient fruit, vessels, attendants, and drink toward the pronoun recipients.
The sequence culminates in the explicit subject رَبُّهُمْ, echoing Allah as subject of both focus verbs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies approach, tractability, circulation, direct drink, and nurture; I infer one hospitality mechanism extending laqqa's direction. The details can alternatively remain a list of independent amenities.

changed_reading.before: Laqqahum records a single delivery of two rewards.
changed_reading.after: Laqqahum inaugurates a world that continually comes to meet them, with environmental and social agency reorganized as welcome and care.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated seeing makes the reward field externally legible as bliss and dominion. This confirms nadra as the visible surface of a condition whose inward register is surur, rather than treating the pair as redundant feelings.

activation_trace.role: Radiant freshness and face-bloom supply the externally legible pole.
Hidden joy and ease supply the inwardly inhabited pole.
Sight by eye or insight makes visibility the explicit access mode to the reward scene.
Good condition and blessing name the comprehensive state that radiance visibly expresses.
Dominion and sovereignty add an externally observable social-spatial dimension to the state.

structural_cues: 76:20 repeats the seeing verb before naming bliss and great dominion.
The focus already coordinates a visually marked noun with an affectively marked noun under one delivery verb.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit seeing, comprehensive bliss, dominion, visible NDR, and hidden joy; I infer a surface/interior relation among them. The pair can alternatively remain two independent gifts within the visible scene.

changed_reading.before: Nadra and surur are two private pleasant sensations.
changed_reading.after: Surur is inwardly inhabited bliss, while nadra is the perceptible interface through which that transformed condition becomes visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reclining on couches in a condition of soft ease supplies bodily and spatial realization for the focus root's settled-support branch. Surur becomes durable rest with posture, support, and place, not an unlocated emotional flash.

activation_trace.role: Joy and ease preserve the direct affective anchor of the focus form.
A place of settled support supplies the latent stable and postural dimension.
Reclining and relying on support bodily enact settled ease.
A couch within a curtained place supplies the stable support on which ease rests.
Softness, ease, and comfortable living generalize the postural scene into a lasting mode of life.

structural_cues: The first sustained reward posture after 76:11 is reclining on couches in 76:13.
76:20 names the encompassing condition as bliss after the intervening scenes of rest and service.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies SRR's settled-support branch plus reclining, couch, and soft living; I infer that the latter concretize the former. Since the focus form directly denotes joy, the support sense remains a texture of that joy rather than a replacement gloss.

changed_reading.before: Surur is a passing internal emotion with no spatial or bodily dimension.
changed_reading.after: Surur is stabilized in the body and environment as supported rest, an ease one can inhabit and continue to inhabit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The scene denies a visible sun yet remains intensely visible through silver and pearl-like brilliance. Against that light-field, nadra can be read as gifted or intrinsic radiance rather than ordinary illumination reflected from the sun.

activation_trace.role: Radiant freshness supplies the humanly received brightness requiring contextual explanation.
Bright metallic purity opens a material-light register for the focus radiance.
The sun and its glare supply the ordinary external light-source explicitly absent from sight.
Silver supplies a bright material distributed through the reward scene.
Pearl-like sparkling supplies visible brilliance without identifying the sun as its source.
Repeated sight confirms that the sunless scene is visually disclosed rather than dark.

structural_cues: 76:13 explicitly negates seeing the sun, not merely its heat.
76:15-20 then accumulates bright materials, sparkling comparison, and repeated sight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies absent visible sun alongside silver, pearl sparkle, sight, and NDR brightness; I infer a non-solar light ecology and locate nadra within it. A live alternative is that absence of sun only marks thermal comfort while ordinary illumination remains implicit.

changed_reading.before: Nadra is ordinary brightness under favorable daylight.
changed_reading.after: Nadra participates in a sun-independent brilliance: radiance is bestowed in and through the recipients rather than borrowed from an oppressive external glare.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later contrast sets attachment to the immediate against leaving a heavy event-day behind one's concern. The focus joy is therefore not generic futurity but the affective result of refusing one temporal orientation and remaining responsive to the deferred day.

activation_trace.role: The severe event-day is the deferred temporal object around which the contrast turns.
Joy and ease supply the eventual affective condition created by the temporal reversal.
Love lodged in the heart supplies affective attachment to the competing temporal object.
Hastening and bringing forward identify immediacy as the preferred horizon.
Leaving something supplies the active neglect of the deferred day.
A severe event-day identifies the neglected future as the same kind of occasion named in the focus.
Weight opposed to lightness explains why the deferred day is easy to leave behind yet consequential.

structural_cues: 76:27 opposes the immediate object of love to a day placed behind the neglectful actors.
The focus recipients had instead feared that day in 76:7 and 76:10 before receiving joy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies competing temporal orientations and the focus day/joy pair; I infer that surur is the eventual affective reversal of refusing immediate attachment. It may more simply be reward after judgment without a specific temporal psychology.

changed_reading.before: Joy is merely delayed pleasure replacing present deprivation.
changed_reading.after: Joy completes a reordering of desire: those who did not abandon the heavy day are freed from it, while the immediacy they refused is replaced by durable ease.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries plant branches into a human reward. It remains anchored because focus NDR explicitly includes foliage bloom and focus SRR includes fresh plant tips, while garden, tender leaf, and green-growth cues sustain one material analogy. Downstream prose should present it as an ecological activation of flourishing, not as a claim that سُرُورًا lexically means vegetation here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The coordinated نَضْرَةً وَسُرُورًا and their packet branches of foliage bloom and fresh plant tips.

activation_trace.role: Fresh beauty and foliage bloom anchor visible human radiance in a vegetal image.
Fresh moist plant tips supply the deliberately distant material texture for surur.
Intertwining and surging vegetation places the focus pair inside active growth.
Tender broad-leaved growth supplies a nearby texture of softness and vitality.
Green tender vegetation confirms freshness as a repeated environmental register.

changed_reading.before: Radiance and joy are abstract human qualities placed inside an otherwise decorative garden.
changed_reading.after: The people themselves participate analogically in the garden's flourishing: visible bloom and inward freshness resemble tender growth that has entered its protected conditions.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's split mapping of QAC ء س ر to bring captivity, bodily binding, and SRR joy into one reversal; it does not establish a surface derivation. It remains anchored in focus سُرُورًا through direct joy and settled-support branches and in two contextual ء س ر occurrences. Downstream prose should label it a split-root activation from boundedness to ease, not an etymological gloss of captive or bodily structure.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun سُرُورًا, activated against contextual أَسِيرًا and أَسْرَهُمْ.

activation_trace.role: Joy and ease keep the outlier anchored in the direct sense of the focus noun.
A place of settled support supplies the positive state opposed to constraining boundedness.
Binding and confinement supply the social form of boundedness embodied by the captive who is fed.
Tight construction and joined bodily structure supply a second, corporeal form of boundedness.
The non-dominant split target's joy-and-ease branch activates the reversal without replacing the contextual surface sense.

changed_reading.before: Surur is an isolated emotion unrelated to the surah's images of captivity and bodily binding.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, surur is the positive unbinding of the whole sequence: social and bodily boundedness give way to joy stabilized as settled ease.

strongest_changes: Prior fulfillment and fear make divine waqa the achieved completion of anticipatory guarding.
The day's evil becomes a spreading, compacting, heavy pressure-field against which protection operates as a barrier.
Renounced human repayment and thanks return as divine recompense and embodied recognition in radiance and joy.
The following garden, shelter, service, and direct drink expand protection and meeting into an inhabitable world organized around care.
Repeated seeing of bliss strengthens the focus pair as visible radiance joined to inward joy.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made 76:11 function as a hinge rather than an isolated reward statement: it gathers the feared day and nontransactional care before it, then unfolds its barrier, encounter, radiance, and ease through shelter, service, visibility, and acknowledged striving afterward. The face-return, non-solar light, vegetal, and split-root binding activations would be easy to lose in a conservative synthesis.
remaining_uncertainties: Nadra's branch includes face-bloom, but the focus syntax does not explicitly say that the radiance is confined to faces.
Spread, compression, and weight may be coordinated material vectors or independent intensifiers of severity.
The settled-support, vegetal, non-solar, and split-root readings are controlled analogical activations, not replacement lexical glosses.
The context supports reading radiance and joy as divine recognition, but it does not force them to exhaust the meaning of recompense.
